description_en: This API recognizes both Hong Kong Permanent Identity Cards and Hong Kong Identity Cards, detecting all card fields such as the Chinese name (if available), English name, Chinese commercial code (if available), date of birth, sex, symbols, and identity card number
description_zh: 支持香港永久性居民身份证和香港居民身份证两种类型的证件识别，已支持全字段识别，包括中文姓名（如有）、英文姓名、中文姓名电码（如有）、出生日期、性别、符号标记、身份证号码等
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-hk-idcard --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/bomzne/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E8%BA%AB%E4%BB%BD%E8%AF%81%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeHKIdcard

parameters.description_en:

- The image URL. The URL cannot exceed 2,048 bytes in length. Base64-encoded images are not supported.

parameters.description_en:
- Specify either this parameter or the Url parameter. You cannot specify both or leave both empty.

- The binary file of the image. The maximum size is 10 MB.

- If you call the API using HTTP, upload the image's binary file in the HTTP body.

- If you call the API using an SDK, place the image in the SDK's body.
